description: The flows this week's work touched, on a fresh scratch database: first-run sign-up with the ZIP and RDO pickers, a tax year with 2551Q, every screen, 2551Q money boxes (a zero box, a filled one, Item 16 with Amended Yes and No), Queue in the dry-run test build, a schedule row deleted, the birth date, Log out. Variants per target where a platform needs its own steps (the Linux window shows the narrow layout). Run with `just e2e <target> smoke --allow-send` under EBIR_TEST_ENV=1 BIR_SFTP_DRY_RUN=1; see docs/proof/E2E.md.
